h1: Pay anyone, anywhere, with their consent.
lede: BenePay is a payments and digital identity platform for organisations that pay people: payees claim their payments and control their own payment data, and payers disburse compliantly across regions, with GDPR built in.

blocks.title: benepay.io: platform and demo
blocks.body: The BenePay site explains the payer and payee experience, the identity model and how disbursements run across regions.

items.label: one platform for both sides of a payment
privacy and consent designed into the identity layer

blocks.text: BenePay carries the same engineering that runs T-Wallet for millions of citizens, pointed at a different problem: organisations that must pay many people they do not bank with. Identity, consent and compliance sit alongside the payment rails, which is what public bodies, insurers and platforms need.

items.title: Payouts and disbursements
items.body: Pay individuals and suppliers across regions from one platform.

items.title: Payee self-service
items.body: Payees verify who they are, choose how to be paid and claim payments without sharing data by email.

items.title: Digital identity and consent
items.body: KYC and consent records held once, controlled by the payee, reused by permission.

items.title: Compliance
items.body: GDPR, data residency and audit trails by design.

items.title: Reconciliation and reporting
items.body: Every payment matched, reported and exportable to finance systems.

items.title: APIs and embedded payments
items.body: Payment and identity flows inside your own applications.

blocks.text: From payment file to claimed funds

items.title: Payer uploads
items.body: A payment run is created or sent by API.

items.title: Payee notified
items.body: The payee receives a secure notification and verifies identity.

items.title: Payee chooses
items.body: Bank account, wallet or other method, held in their own profile.

items.title: Payment made
items.body: Funds settle through the appropriate regional rails.

items.title: Reconciled
items.body: Status and evidence flow back to the payer’s finance systems.

blocks.text: What Purview runs behind the platform

items.title: Identity-first payments, run as a service
items.body: Purview operates the platform, the regional payment connections, the KYC and consent layer and the reconciliation reporting, so clients run disbursements without building a payments team.

items.title: Public sector
items.body: Grants, benefits, refunds and compensation to citizens.

items.title: Insurers

items.title: Platforms and gig economy
items.body: Paying contributors and workers across borders.

items.title: Enterprises
items.body: Supplier and expense payouts with consent-based data handling.

items.a: A payments and digital identity SaaS platform from the Purview Group for organisations that pay individuals and suppliers.
Payees control their own identity and payment data; payers pay compliantly across regions without collecting bank details by email.
Privacy and consent are designed into the platform, with data residency and audit trails.
Yes, through APIs for payment and identity flows inside your applications.
Purview runs the platform, rails and compliance as a managed service.

blocks.text: See benepay.io, or talk to the payments team that runs a state wallet.
